# Aranzulla.it

> > Comprehensive Italian-language technology tutorials covering Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS devices with practical guides for everyday computing tasks.

Aranzulla.it is Italy's leading tech tutorial website created by Salvatore Aranzulla, offering step-by-step guides for software, file management, security, and productivity across all major platforms including Windows 11, Microsoft Office, and mobile operating systems.

## Key Topics

- Windows tutorials
- macOS guides
- Android how-tos
- iOS and iPadOS
- PDF tools and editing
- IP address tracking
- File management
- Email security and spam protection
- Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint)
- Cross-platform software
- Privacy and security
- Photo editing and printing
- Browser extensions (Chrome, Edge)
- Automation and productivity
- Beginner-friendly guides

## File and Document Management

- [Come modificare un PDF gratis](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-modificare-file-pdf-online-11287.html): Free PDF editing tutorial using LibreOffice, PDFill, PDFescape, and Xodo
- [Come sproteggere un PDF](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-sproteggere-i-documenti-pdf-protetti-4992.html): Remove PDF password protection using QPDF, PDFCrack, and online tools
- [Come dividere grossi file](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-dividere-un-file-grande-in-file-piu-piccoli-837.html): Tutorial on splitting large files using 7-Zip, Keka, and RAR compression
- [Come cancellare file doppi](https://www.aranzulla.it/cancelliamo-i-doppioni-dei-file-e-i-file-inutili-762.html): Remove duplicate files on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS platforms
- [Come cancellare file dal computer](https://www.aranzulla.it/cancellare-una-grande-quantita-di-file-e-cartelle-in-meno-di-due-secondi-1592.html): Quick guide to deleting large quantities of files on Windows and Mac
- [Come scannerizzare documenti con la fotocamera](https://www.aranzulla.it/scannerizzare-un-documento-con-una-fotocamera-digitale-3642.html): Guide to scanning documents using smartphone cameras and Google Drive
- [Correttore ortografico italiano per Windows](https://www.aranzulla.it/correttore-ortografico-italiano-per-windows-10459.html): Italian spell checker guide for Windows 11, Word, and web browsers

## Security and Privacy

- [Come evitare email spam](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-proteggere-la-tua-e-mail-dallo-spam-5431.html): Guide to protecting Gmail and other email accounts from spam and phishing
- [Come recuperare account Hotmail rubato](https://www.aranzulla.it/recuperare-un-account-di-windows-live-messenger-rubato-o-bloccato-586.html): How to recover stolen or blocked Hotmail/Outlook Microsoft accounts
- [Come creare una partizione nascosta](https://www.aranzulla.it/creare-partizioni-nascoste-8400.html): Tutorial on creating hidden partitions for privacy on Windows and macOS

## Network and IP Address Tools

- [Come rintracciare un indirizzo IP](https://www.aranzulla.it/localizzare-un-indirizzo-ip-800.html): Guide to tracing IP addresses, covering public/local IPs and geolocation
- [Come scoprire e visualizzare qual è il proprio indirizzo IP](https://www.aranzulla.it/scoprire-quale-il-proprio-indirizzo-ip-299.html): Discover your public and private IP addresses with networking basics

## System Maintenance and Productivity

- [Come aggiornare programmi](https://www.aranzulla.it/tenere-aggiornati-tutti-i-programmi-del-proprio-computer-801.html): Guide to updating software on Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS devices
- [Come automatizzare le operazioni più frequenti al PC](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-automatizzare-le-operazioni-piu-frequenti-al-pc-8934.html): Automate PC tasks using Power Automate on Windows and macOS shortcuts
- [Come usare ClipX per copia e incolla](https://www.aranzulla.it/copia-ed-incolla-alla-massima-potenza-con-clipx-1003.html): Enhanced clipboard management tutorial using ClipX for Windows
- [Creare post-it sul desktop gratis](https://www.aranzulla.it/post-it-sul-desktop-gratis-7486.html): Create virtual sticky notes on Windows and macOS desktops for free

## Photo and Media Tools

- [Come creare fototessere](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-fare-fototessere-al-pc-9909.html): Tutorial for creating passport photos on Windows, macOS, and Android
- [Come creare un album fotografico](https://www.aranzulla.it/come-creare-un-album-fotografico-on-line-5217.html): Create photo albums online and print with Saal Digital and PowerPoint
- [Come aggiungere effetti speciali alla webcam](https://www.aranzulla.it/aggiungere-effetti-speciali-alla-nostra-webcam-1218.html): Add special effects to webcam using ManyCam, SplitCam, and Photo Booth

## Language and Translation

- [Come tradurre automaticamente](https://www.aranzulla.it/tradurre-un-testo-da-una-lingua-ad-unaltra-con-piu-traduttori-automatici-1685.html): Tutorial on automatic translation using Google Translator and Bing tools
